tags.name: Activity
tags.description:
« Activité du compte » (spec §10, §105): what happened to the account and who did it, to answer
"why did this value change?".

tags.name: Coach
tags.description:
The Coach (spec §62–70): at most three recommendations, the week's adherence, the last weekly
report. It never changes anything by itself.

tags.name: CoachSettings
tags.description: How the Coach speaks (spec §131) and the pace it judges the weight against.

tags.name: CoachRecommendation
tags.description:
A recommendation of the Coach (spec §68–70), with its "why", the figures it was made on and
what the user decided.

tags.name: CoachWeeklyReport
tags.description: The report of a finished week (spec §59), as drawn when the week ended.

tags.name: Export
tags.description: An export of the user's data (spec §104, ADR-0030): made by the worker, then downloadable for a day.

tags.name: ExportDomain
tags.description: What an export can cover.

tags.name: ExportDownload
tags.description: A signed link to a ready export's archive, asked for when the user downloads it (traced).

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Resource 'Account' operations.

tags.name: SignInProviders
tags.description: External providers the PWA may offer on the sign-in page (none unless configured).

tags.name: SignIn
tags.description:
Either the device is signed in (`account`), or a second factor is expected
(`twoFactorRequired`, then POST /auth/sign-in/second-factor).

tags.name: EmailVerification
tags.description: Resource 'EmailVerification' operations.

tags.name: PasswordChange
tags.description: Resource 'PasswordChange' operations.

tags.name: PasswordReset
tags.description: Resource 'PasswordReset' operations.

tags.name: PasswordResetRequest
tags.description: Resource 'PasswordResetRequest' operations.

tags.name: SignOut
tags.description: Resource 'SignOut' operations.

tags.name: AccountDeletion
tags.description: « Supprimer mon compte » (spec §103, ADR-0030): when the account will be erased.

tags.name: DataPolicy
tags.description:
The delays that apply to the user's data (spec §103–105), from the server's configuration, so
that the PWA never states one of its own.

tags.name: DashboardLayout
tags.description:
The home dashboard's widgets, in order, and which are shown (spec §13, §82), kept with the
account so that every device shows the same dashboard.

tags.name: TimeZone
tags.description:
The time zone of the user's devices, which scheduled notifications and the nightly Coach
analysis follow (ADR-0029). Read with the account (`GET /api/me`).

tags.name: Session
tags.description: Resource 'Session' operations.

tags.name: RecoveryCodes
tags.description: Plain recovery codes, returned exactly once: only their hashes are stored.

tags.name: TwoFactorDisabling
tags.description: Resource 'TwoFactorDisabling' operations.

tags.name: TwoFactorSetup
tags.description: Resource 'TwoFactorSetup' operations.

tags.name: NotificationInbox
tags.description:
The inbox as a whole: the checks the app runs when it opens, the unread count of the bell, and
marking everything read.

tags.name: Notification
tags.description: Something worth telling the user (spec §75), in the app until read.

tags.name: NotificationSettings
tags.description: Which notifications the user wants (spec §75) and when to be left alone (spec §76), in their time.

tags.name: BarcodeScan
tags.description:
Spec §20: scan → Symfony → product database → normalised proposal → user confirmation. A scan
saves nothing; POST /nutrition/barcode/confirm does, once the user agreed.

tags.name: MealBuilder
tags.description: Meal Builder (spec §28): what is left, and meals that fill it. Add one with POST /nutrition/entries/batch.

tags.name: FavoriteMeal
tags.description: A meal eaten often, logged again in one go (POST /nutrition/favorite-meals/{id}/log).

tags.name: Food
tags.description: Resource 'Food' operations.

tags.name: JournalEntry
tags.description: Journal writes. Each answers with the NutritionDay it changed (read an entry through its day).

tags.name: NutritionAverages
tags.description:
Daily averages over the logged days of the last 7 or 30 days: a day with nothing logged is
left out rather than counted as a day without eating.

tags.name: NutritionDay
tags.description:
A day of the food journal, meal by meal, against the target in force that day.
Journal writes (JournalEntry) answer with the day they changed, so the screen is redrawn from one response.

tags.name: NutritionHistory
tags.description:
Calories and proteins over a period (spec §55–56): each complete day logged, each week's
mean, the mean of the period, and the target in force today.

tags.name: Recipe
tags.description: A dish made of foods. Its values follow its foods; journal entries keep those of the day they were logged.

tags.name: EnergyEstimate
tags.description: The calculation shown step by step: BMR → expenditure → surplus/deficit → targets.

tags.name: MealSplit
tags.description: Percent of the day's calories planned per meal; the five shares add up to 100.

tags.name: NutritionTarget
tags.description: Daily targets from a day on. Never edited: each change is a new entry of the history.

tags.name: Measure
tags.description:
A measure one can take (spec §54): a body part (`name` null, the app names it) or one of the
user's own.

tags.name: Measurements
tags.description: The measurements of one of the user's days: one set a day, identified by the day.

tags.name: MeasurementsSummary
tags.description: Every measure over a period (spec §54–55).

tags.name: PhotoSession
tags.description: The photos of a day, with that day's weight and measurements, or the latest before it (spec §61).

tags.name: ProgressPhoto
tags.description:
A progress photo (spec §60, ADR-0027): never public, read through links that expire after a
few minutes (ask for the photo again for new ones).

tags.name: WeighIn
tags.description: The weight of one of the user's days: one a day, identified by the day.

tags.name: WeightGoal
tags.description: The weight goal followed, its milestones, and where the user stands on it (spec §52–53).

tags.name: WeightSummary
tags.description:
The weight page (spec §51–55): the latest weigh-in, the 7 and 30-day averages and the speed
ending today, the change since the first weigh-in, the goal, and the chart of a period.

tags.name: ClientConfig
tags.description: The PWA's deployment settings (docs/MONITORING.md): public, read at start, cached briefly.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Resource 'Health' operations.

tags.name: Exercise
tags.description:
A movement from the shared library or one of the user's own, with what it is usually done
with (proposed when it is added to a program) and the user's standing cue for it.

tags.name: ExerciseProgress
tags.description: Personal records of an exercise and its workouts over time.

tags.name: TrainingAnalytics
tags.description:
The training of a period (spec §57): sessions, frequency, working sets, reps, tonnage and
records beaten, in all and week by week.

tags.name: NextWorkout
tags.description: The next day of the active program (spec §13: « prochain entraînement », « bouton démarrer »).

tags.name: Program
tags.description:
A training plan: days of exercises (a block of several is a superset). Changing its days
records a new version; past workouts stay tied to the version they followed.

tags.name: Workout
tags.description:
A training session (spec §42–46). Ids are chosen by the device and every write is idempotent:
the PWA records sets offline and sends them again until they are acknowledged.

tags.name: WorkoutExercise
tags.description: An exercise added to a workout, at the next position (sending it again changes nothing).

tags.name: WorkoutPlan
tags.description:
What starting a program day would plan, with each exercise's cue and last performance: the
device keeps it, to start the workout even offline.

tags.name: WorkoutSet
tags.description: A set of a workout, sent by the device as soon as it is done (and again until acknowledged).
